# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" as the application name.
- **System Clock**: Shows "Oct 23 01:25" indicating the current date and time.
- **System Tray Icons**: Located on the top-right corner, includes icons for:
  - Network connectivity
  - Sound/volume control
  - Power button
- **Window Control Buttons**: On the far right of the title bar, includes:
  - Minimize button (dash icon)
  - Maximize/Restore button (square icon)
  - Close button (X icon)

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: From left to right: File, Edit, Selection, View, Go, Run, Terminal, Help.
- **File Menu**: Currently open and expanded, displaying a comprehensive list of file-related commands.

## File Menu Contents

- **New File Options**:
  - New Text File (Ctrl+N)
  - New File... (Alt+Ctrl+N)
  - New Window (Ctrl+Shift+N)
- **Open File Options**:
  - Open File... (Ctrl+O)
  - Open Folder... [Ctrl+K Ctrl+O]
  - Open Workspace from File...
  - Open Recent (with right-pointing arrow indicating submenu)
- **Workspace Management**:
  - Add Folder to Workspace...
  - Save Workspace As...
  - Duplicate Workspace
- **Save Operations**:
  - Save (Ctrl+S)
  - Save As... (Ctrl+Shift+S)
  - Save All
- **Share Option**: Contains a right-pointing arrow indicating a submenu.
- **Auto Save**: Listed as a standalone option.
- **Preferences**: Contains a right-pointing arrow indicating a submenu.
- **File Management**:
  - Revert File
  - Close Editor
  - Close Folder [Ctrl+K F]
  - Close Window (Alt+F4)
- **Exit**: Listed as the final option with shortcut Ctrl+Q.

## Main Application Interface

### Welcome Page Content

- **Title**: "Visual Studio Code" in large, prominent text.
- **Subtitle**: "Editing evolved" in smaller text below the main title.

### Start Section

- **Section Title**: "Start"
- **Options**:
  - New File... (with document icon)
  - Open File... (with folder icon)
  - Open Folder... (with folder icon)
  - Connect to... (with cloud icon)

### Recent Section

- **Section Title**: "Recent"
- **Message**: "You have no recent folders, open a folder to start." (with "open a folder" as a hyperlink)

### Walkthroughs Section

- **Section Title**: "Walkthroughs"
- **Walkthrough Options**:
  - Get Started with VS Code (with star icon) — Description: "Customize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding" — This option is highlighted with a blue underline.
  - Learn the Fundamentals (with lightbulb icon)

## Status and Settings

- **Startup Setting**: At the bottom-right corner, a checkbox labeled "Show welcome page on startup" is checked.

## Left Sidebar (Activity Bar)

- **Application Icons**: A vertical dock on the left side of the window, including:
  - Google Chrome
  - Microsoft Edge
  - Visual Studio Code (blue icon)
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - App Store
  - Help (question mark icon)
  - Trash
- **User and Settings Icons**: At the bottom of the sidebar:
  - User profile icon
  - Settings gear icon with a notification badge (number 1)
- **Bottom Dock**: Includes:
  - Grid icon (application launcher)
  - Status indicators: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 suggestions

## Editor Tabs

- **Active Tab**: "Home" tab is visible with a close button (X) on the right.
- **Tab Bar**: Located at the top of the editor area, showing the active tab.

## Visual Styling

- **Theme**: Dark theme with black background and light gray text.
- **Icons**: Consistent use of icons for actions and file types.
- **Highlighting**: The "Get Started with VS Code" walkthrough option is highlighted with a blue underline to indicate selection or active state.
